text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr and I are on our way back from an outing when we notice that a certain corner of the shopping district is particularly busy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe… It seems that area's blooming nicely. It's almost as if a gathering wind is blowing.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my, that inn…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I've heard that it's surrounded by gorgeous mountains, and that a soothing breeze often blows through the area.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Supposedly, the place is brimming with little critters and birdies—all kinds of forest wildlife.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I do. Let's trust that this chance encounter is a roseate current.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We head off to purchase some daily necessities and get our hands on a raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr gives the raffle machine a powerful spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, well this is a surprise. To think I'd actually win…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It feels like a warm summer breeze blowing in winter… Hehe. Life's just full of surprises, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So, should we go when the balmy breeze blows? Or amidst the autumnal currents?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I do think it'd be best to go when we can relax at our leisure, like a tender breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Things are hectic enough at the moment between races and training. A vacation might only exhaust us further.
choice_data_list: How about we shelve the idea until things have calmed down?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, good idea. Let's do that. We've happened upon an auspicious updraft, so we should wait for an opportune airstream.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe… It feels like those days we spend waiting for the winds of the new year to blow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm very excited. How about you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Of course you are. We were both there when the roseate current blew, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …You don't want to come?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let's go, then. A trip of lulling winds awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how I came to promise Yamanin Zephyr that we would go on a trip to the hot springs together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: First prize… So I was one step short of the grand prize.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, I shouldn't complain. The breeze was sufficiently pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's a day of natural spontaneity, and we were lucky enough to feel the touch of a divine rumble.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Now, following that stroke of good luck… I'd like to enjoy this in a place where a refreshing breeze blows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You're welcome to join me if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We head up a nearby hill, where a breathtaking view awaits at the top.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Okay, here you are. I got some tea for us too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The clouds are a beautiful reddish color, aren't they? It'll be twilight soon, and a starlit breeze will be upon us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gazing at the scenery, we split the hamburger steak between us.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my, it seems the roseate current has passed us by.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe, but we've won ourselves so many fine-looking carrots. What a rare blessing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Like the auspicious updraft, their leaves are just lovely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I can't eat all these by myself, though, and even if I share them with you, there are still too many…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I've just thought of a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: There's some homemade carrot cake over there. You're welcome to have some, Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, you made all that cake?! Whoa! Gimme some!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You know, Zephyr, your cooking always has such nice, mild flavor… The taste's real relaxing somehow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my, thank you… Your words come as a harmonious breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So, the taste's relaxing… Perhaps I'll take some to Trainer later… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my, third place… The grand prize blew far off at sea, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It appears this raffle was something of a spiraling whirlwind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I knew this might happen, but… Hehe, well, I suppose it's no good getting your hopes up with these things.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That said, we're lucky to have been blessed with this one carrot.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I don't want it to go to waste… How about I whip something up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Making use of the carrot, Yamanin Zephyr rustles up some dinner for us both.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's simmered carrot and wild greens with seasonal fish and white rice.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Please enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us savor a pleasant and subtly flavored meal.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my… I suppose it wasn't to be.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Actually, no—we don't have to turn this breeze into a full-blown haboob.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's no use wallowing in defeat.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm sure a new wind will blow before long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she tries to stay positive, Yamanin Zephyr seems ever so slightly disappointed.
